prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no kind of change has at least 2 tests yet to establish a pattern.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) won and was helpful, but evidence remains thin with only 1 test.
Adding a pet preview screen (adoption, new_screen) showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive story intro flow: Transform the intro story screen into an interactive scroll flow where users select companion goals before choosing their creation path. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an average duration of 514s, showing early onboarding friction.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop companion spotlight welcome: Redesign the final home welcome screen into a spotlight view showcasing shortcut keys and interaction modes. (why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% and users report confusion on how to interact with the pet post-onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account persistence reassurance copy: Add explicit reassurance copy to the sign-in screen confirming that account sign-in securely saves pet progress across devices. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting missing pets or account resets after signing back in.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom photo generation hint: Add photo quality guidance and lighting hints on the photo upload screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or incorrect visual outcomes.)
4: [home, wait_info] Generation status tip carousel: Display a dynamic tip carousel and status text while waiting for pet assets to generate. (why: The waiting phase on the home step has high mean time (2336s), leading to user drop-off.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop notification readiness alert: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering finishes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s (~38 mins), indicating users minimize the app and forget to return.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate badge seal: Add an official companion badge component and reward sound trigger to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption step conversion is only 60.9%, needing stronger emotional payoff to encourage completion.)
7: [sign_in, reorder] Post-certificate sign in reorder: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after certificate viewing rather than after asset waiting. (why: Moving sign-in after adoption proved successful in earlier tests; placing it right after certificate generation secures account commitment while motivation is highest.)
